# Qt 6.8 (QtCore + QtGui), vendored — `apps/hello-qt-gui`'s dependency

Real, largely unmodified Qt 6.8 source — not a reimplementation — plus the
real third-party libraries it bundles, vendored so
[`apps/hello-qt-gui`](../../apps/hello-qt-gui) builds offline with a plain
`make`. It is the **full** QtCore + QtGui closure (`QGuiApplication`,
`QWindow`/`QRasterWindow`, `QPainter`, `QImage`, `QFont`, the event loop,
`QThread`, `QRegularExpression`, ...), unlike the earlier
[`third_party/qt6`](../qt6) tree which is the small `QT_BOOTSTRAPPED` subset
behind `apps/hello-qt` and is left untouched.

## Layout

| Path | What it is |
|---|---|
| `qtbase/` | **Real Qt/third-party files**, in their upstream paths (`qtbase/src/corelib/...`, `src/gui/...`, `src/plugins/platforms/minimal/`, `src/3rdparty/{freetype,harfbuzz-ng,pcre2,double-conversion,siphash,tinycbor}`, `mkspecs/common/posix`). 1,678 files, copied verbatim from `qtbase` branch `6.8` except the 11 patched ones below. Only files the compiler actually reads are here — the set is derived, not guessed (`tools/vendor.py`). |
| `koppios/include/` | What `syncqt` + CMake would generate: the flattened `QtCore/`, `QtGui/`, `qpa/` include trees (relative symlinks into `qtbase/`, plus the CamelCase forwarding headers) and the per-module config headers (`qconfig.h`, `qtcore-config*.h`, `qtgui-config*.h`, export headers, `qconfig.cpp`). The config headers started as the ones a real 6.10 desktop build produces and were edited to this port's feature set (see below). |
| `koppios/mocgen/` | Output of the real `moc` 6.8.4 (built from `qtbase/src/tools/moc`) for every `Q_OBJECT`/`Q_GADGET` header in the closure. Checked in so the build needs no `moc`. Paths inside are `../../qtbase/...`, which is why `mocgen/` and `qtbase/` sit at this depth. |
| `koppios/*.cpp`, `koppios/freetype/`, `koppios/dc_patched/` | **Not Qt source** — the koppios glue (see below). |
| `koppios/sources.mk`, `koppios/incs.mk` | Generated by `tools/vendor.py`: the translation-unit lists and the ordered `-I` list the Makefile consumes. |
| `LICENSES/` | SPDX texts for everything vendored. |
| `tools/` | How this tree was produced and how to refresh it. |

## The patched Qt files

Every change is marked inline (`grep -r "koppios addition" qtbase`):

| File | Change | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `src/corelib/global/qsystemdetection.h` | `Q_OS_KOPPIOS` is checked **first** and falls through to generic `Q_OS_UNIX` | The host `g++` predefines `__linux__`; without this Qt picks `Q_OS_LINUX` paths (epoll, `/proc`, and an inline `QThread::currentThreadId()` that reads `%gs:8`). |
| 7 × `thread_local` (`qlogging.cpp`, `qloggingregistry.cpp`, `qobject.cpp`, `qproperty.cpp`, `qregularexpression.cpp`, `qthread_unix.cpp`, `qtimezoneprivate_tz.cpp`) | `thread_local` removed (plain `static`) | This kernel sets up no `%gs` TLS segment and GCC 15 has no `-femulated-tls`; native `thread_local` page-faults at address ~0. Single-threaded closure only. |
| `src/gui/kernel/qguiapplication.cpp` | `init_platform()` calls `qt_koppios_create_platform_integration()` | There is no `dlopen()` plugin loader. |
| `src/plugins/platforms/minimal/qminimalintegration.cpp` | `fontDatabase()` returns `qt_koppios_create_font_database()` | Qt's own minimal platform plugin has no usable font database without fontconfig. |
| `src/corelib/thread/qthreadpool.cpp` | `QThreadPoolPrivate::qtGuiInstance()` always returns null (Qt's own `QT_NO_GUI_THREADPOOL` path) | Qt parallelizes big image fills/conversions through it. A worker thread's stack is placed at a fixed offset above the image, which collides with a heap that has grown in place, and thread exit then unmaps live heap pages (a kernel layout bug, see below). Image code falls back to its serial path. |

`koppios/dc_patched/string-to-double.cc` is a patched **copy** of the upstream
file (`std::locale::classic()`'s `ctype<char>::tolower` is plain ASCII
`tolower`; libstdc++'s locale machinery is not available here).

## The koppios glue (`koppios/`)

* `qt_koppios_platform.cpp` — subclasses Qt's own `QMinimalIntegration`:
  windows send an expose event when shown, and the backing store's `flush()`
  quantizes the `QImage` Qt painted (adaptive palette: 16 reserved greys plus a
  240-colour median cut of the first frame, RGB555 lookup table, luminance-only
  4×4 Bayer dither, so smooth gradients do not band or tint) and presents it
  with `gfx_open`/`gfx_palette`/`gfx_blit` (syscalls 22–25, the
  full-screen-grab path `apps/doom` uses).
* `qkoppiosfontdatabase.cpp` — a `QFreeTypeFontDatabase` that registers
  `/rd/font.ttf`.
* `qshader_koppios.cpp` — five `QShader` members the RHI references; real
  `qshader.cpp` needs zlib.
* `qstandardpaths_koppios.cpp` — no per-user directories exist.
* `freetype/` — FreeType's module list trimmed to TrueType + smooth/mono
  rasterizers + `psnames` + autofit; memory-only `ftsystem`; gzip stubs.
* `../../lib/qfileengine_koppios.cpp`, `../../lib/qfsfileengine_koppios_stub.cpp`
  — Qt's `QAbstractFileEngineHandler` over the kernel's file syscalls (these
  live in `lib/`, built by the app's Makefile with the Qt flags).

## Configuration decisions (all forced by a real failure)

* `QT_STATIC`, `QT_NO_COMPRESS`; `zstd`, `icu`, `glib`, `inotify`, `renameat2`,
  `forkfd_pidfd` off in QtCore; `evdev`, `kms`, `xkbcommon`, `wayland`, `xcb`,
  `fontconfig`, `vnc`, ... off in QtGui. Legacy `QT_NO_<FEATURE>` macros must
  agree with the `QT_FEATURE_*` flags (see the `Makefile`).
* **No** `-fkeep-inline-functions`: it made object files ~50× larger and got
  `ar`/`ld` OOM-killed.
* `-DQT_QPA_DEFAULT_PLATFORM_NAME='"minimal"'`.
* Some `.cpp` files in Qt are `#include`d by another `.cpp` and must not be
  compiled alone (`qchar.cpp`, `qstringmatcher.cpp`, `qcssscanner.cpp`, ...);
  the derived source list excludes them.
* The app must pass an **absolute** `argv[0]` (`/rd/hqtgui`): there is no
  `PATH` search, and `QLibraryInfo` asserts if `applicationDirPath()` is empty.

## What the kernel/libc had to grow for this

Real fixes in `lib/` that every user-space app can use: glibc-shaped `ctype`
tables, a real `getcwd`, `setlocale`/`nl_langinfo` for `C.UTF-8`, an
in-process `eventfd` + working `ppoll`/`poll` (so Qt's *real* Unix event
dispatcher runs), a millisecond `clock_gettime`, `wcscoll`, and VFS-aware
absolute paths in the Qt file engine.

## Known limitations

* No OpenGL/Vulkan/RHI backend, no accessibility, no drag-and-drop, no
  clipboard, no image-format plugins (PNG/JPEG), no dynamic plugins.
* Compressed `.qrc` resources and `.qsb` shaders are unsupported (no zlib).
* Input is a polled raw scancode ring injected as key events; no mouse yet.
* Output is the kernel's 8-bit indexed `gfx_blit`, so colour is limited to one
  256-entry palette per frame sequence (built from the first frame).
* Kernel bug found along the way and **not** fixed here: a secondary thread's
  stack/heap are placed at fixed offsets above the image, so a thread created
  after the main heap has grown past that point overlaps it (thread exit then
  unmaps live heap pages). This port therefore avoids creating GUI worker threads (see the
  `qthreadpool.cpp` patch above); revert that patch once the kernel is fixed.
